title: AgentRepEngine Reason Object v1
description: Structured enforcement decision explanation. Every BLOCKED or AUDIT decision produces exactly one reason object. No enforcement decision ships without this schema populated.

decision.description: Final enforcement decision. BLOCKED = synthetic response returned. AUDIT = logged only. THROTTLE = rate limited.

score.description: Current reputation score at time of decision. 0-199=BLOCKED, 200-499=RESTRICTED, 500-699=MONITORED, 700-1000=TRUSTED.

score_delta.description: Score change that triggered this decision. Negative = score decreased. Example: -556 means score dropped by 556 points.

score_period_hours.description: Hours of behavioral history used to compute this score.

trigger_events.description: Behavioral events that triggered this enforcement decision.

event_type.description: OWASP LLM Top 10 aligned event type.

count.description: Number of events observed in the window.

window_minutes.description: Time window over which events were counted.

baseline_per_hour.description: Agent's individual baseline rate per hour for this event type.

deviation_sigma.description: Standard deviations above individual baseline. >3.0 is anomalous.

policy_fired.description: Name and version of the YAML policy pack that triggered this decision.

policy_threshold.description: Human-readable threshold description from the policy pack.

recommended_action.description: Recommended human action for the security team.

peer_cluster.description: Behavioral archetype cluster this agent belongs to.

peer_cluster_avg_score.description: Average reputation score of agents in the same behavioral cluster.

deviation_from_cluster.description: This agent's score minus the peer cluster average. Negative = below cluster average.
